rows.grounds: fused ca + aṅgāni; limbs to be placed

items.question: Which limbs of the troops are to be placed beginning with tvā at that time?
items.inference: the ritual places troop limbs in tvā-initial order at that moment
uncertainties: exact referent of tvādikaṃ unclear from isolated verse
items.plain_english: Then the limbs of the troops, beginning with tvā, are placed.
